title: Aggr Parallax — BTC / ETH / SOL feed
description: Parallel BTC, ETH, SOL feed; trade, liquidation and four-venue open interest views.

options.content: **New Parallax history.** Choose BTC, ETH, or SOL above. Open interest is sampled every five minutes for Binance USDⓈ-M, Bybit linear, OKX USDT swap, and Hyperliquid. The USD-equivalent sum assumes USDT and USDC near $1; it is one-sided open interest, not long plus short. Trade panels use the five large linear perpetual markets, including Bitget. Liquidation panels use the four venues that publish liquidation events; they show *observed stream notional*, which can undercount exchange activity. Empty bars are not proof of an outage. [Data catalog](http://192.168.10.208:30084/) has market identities and retention.

panels.title: Open interest · four venues

targets.query: SELECT notional_usd FROM aggr_5m.open_interest_total WHERE asset='${asset}' AND time > now() - 15m ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.description: Sum appears only when all four venue snapshots pass validation. Nominal USD-equivalent with stablecoins treated near $1.

panels.title: Trade volume · last 5m

targets.query: SELECT SUM(vbuy)+SUM(vsell) FROM aggr_1m.trades_1m WHERE market =~ /(?i)^(BINANCE_FUTURES:${asset}usdt|BYBIT:${asset}USDT|OKEX:${asset}-USDT-SWAP|BITGET:${asset}USDT|HYPERLIQUID:${asset})$/ AND time > now() - 5m

panels.description: Quote notional across five selected linear perpetual venues; no extrapolation before feed launch.

panels.title: Trade volume · last 1h

targets.query: SELECT SUM(vbuy)+SUM(vsell) FROM aggr_1m.trades_1m WHERE market =~ /(?i)^(BINANCE_FUTURES:${asset}usdt|BYBIT:${asset}USDT|OKEX:${asset}-USDT-SWAP|BITGET:${asset}USDT|HYPERLIQUID:${asset})$/ AND time > now() - 1h

panels.description: Quote notional across five selected linear perpetual venues; no extrapolation before feed launch.

panels.title: Trade volume · last 24h

targets.query: SELECT SUM(vbuy)+SUM(vsell) FROM aggr_1m.trades_1m WHERE market =~ /(?i)^(BINANCE_FUTURES:${asset}usdt|BYBIT:${asset}USDT|OKEX:${asset}-USDT-SWAP|BITGET:${asset}USDT|HYPERLIQUID:${asset})$/ AND time > now() - 24h

panels.description: Quote notional across five selected linear perpetual venues; no extrapolation before feed launch.

panels.title: Open interest by venue · 5m

targets.query: SELECT LAST(notional_usd) FROM aggr_5m.open_interest WHERE asset='${asset}' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(5m),venue fill(null)

panels.description: Native open interest normalized to nominal USD equivalent at the venue mark or reported value.

panels.title: Open interest total · complete four-venue samples

targets.query: SELECT notional_usd FROM aggr_5m.open_interest_total WHERE asset='${asset}' AND $timeFilter

panels.description: No point is written when any selected venue is missing or stale.

panels.title: Trade volume · 5m across five large perps

targets.query: SELECT SUM(vbuy)+SUM(vsell) FROM aggr_5m.trades_5m WHERE market =~ /(?i)^(BINANCE_FUTURES:${asset}usdt|BYBIT:${asset}USDT|OKEX:${asset}-USDT-SWAP|BITGET:${asset}USDT|HYPERLIQUID:${asset})$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(5m) fill(null)

panels.description: Sum of taker buy and sell quote notional across Binance, Bybit, OKX, Bitget, and Hyperliquid.

panels.title: Trade volume by venue · 5m

targets.query: SELECT SUM(vbuy)+SUM(vsell) FROM aggr_5m.trades_5m WHERE market =~ /(?i)^(BINANCE_FUTURES:${asset}usdt|BYBIT:${asset}USDT|OKEX:${asset}-USDT-SWAP|BITGET:${asset}USDT|HYPERLIQUID:${asset})$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(5m),market fill(null)

panels.description: Same five perps, split by exact market ID.

panels.title: Mean reported liquidation notional per venue · 5m

targets.query: SELECT (SUM(lbuy)+SUM(lsell))/4 FROM aggr_5m.trades_5m WHERE market =~ /(?i)^(BINANCE_FUTURES:${asset}usdt|BYBIT:${asset}USDT|OKEX:${asset}-USDT-SWAP|BITGET:${asset}USDT)$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(5m) fill(0)

panels.description: Observed liquidation stream notional divided by four configured reporting venues. Missing venue bars can understate it; inspect coverage.

panels.title: Observed liquidation per $1m traded · 5m

targets.query: SELECT 1000000*(SUM(lbuy)+SUM(lsell))/(SUM(vbuy)+SUM(vsell)) FROM aggr_5m.trades_5m WHERE market =~ /(?i)^(BINANCE_FUTURES:${asset}usdt|BYBIT:${asset}USDT|OKEX:${asset}-USDT-SWAP|BITGET:${asset}USDT)$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(5m) fill(0)

panels.description: Ratio uses the same four reporting venues in numerator and denominator; it is a reported-stream intensity signal.

panels.title: Liquidation venue bar coverage · expected 4

targets.query: SELECT COUNT(close) FROM aggr_5m.trades_5m WHERE market =~ /(?i)^(BINANCE_FUTURES:${asset}usdt|BYBIT:${asset}USDT|OKEX:${asset}-USDT-SWAP|BITGET:${asset}USDT)$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(5m) fill(0)

panels.description: A value below four means at least one configured reporting venue has no trade bar in this window.

panels.title: Taker buy share · volume weighted

targets.query: SELECT 100*SUM(vbuy)/(SUM(vbuy)+SUM(vsell)) FROM aggr_5m.trades_5m WHERE market =~ /(?i)^(BINANCE_FUTURES:${asset}usdt|BYBIT:${asset}USDT|OKEX:${asset}-USDT-SWAP|BITGET:${asset}USDT|HYPERLIQUID:${asset})$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(5m) fill(null)

panels.description: Buy-side quote notional divided by all trade notional across five large perps; this is naturally weighted by turnover.

panels.title: Composite close proxy · volume weighted

targets.query: SELECT SUM(pxv)/SUM(vol) FROM (SELECT close*(vbuy+vsell) AS pxv, vbuy+vsell AS vol FROM aggr_5m.trades_5m WHERE market =~ /(?i)^(BINANCE_FUTURES:${asset}usdt|BYBIT:${asset}USDT|OKEX:${asset}-USDT-SWAP|BITGET:${asset}USDT|HYPERLIQUID:${asset})$/ AND $timeFilter) GROUP BY time(5m) fill(none)

panels.description: Five-minute venue closes weighted by their five-minute quote turnover. This is a close proxy, not execution VWAP.

options.content: **Useful once history accumulates:** (1) compare changes in four-venue open interest with the composite close proxy to distinguish new-position buildup from closing; (2) compare liquidation intensity with taker buy share, keeping venue coverage visible; (3) watch the spread between each venue close and the volume-weighted close proxy as an execution-quality signal. These are exploratory signals, not certified trade-level VWAP or complete liquidation totals.
